title: Fix the merged doc comment on settle_expired_pending_begin, and make C1 prove the attempt-start expiry check
outcome: engram_prepared_begin_grant_expired carries its own doc comment again, and settle_expired_pending_begin's comment describes only itself. The C1 expired-grant test fails if the attempt-start check is removed: it asserts that no re-acknowledgement fence runs before the expired pending begin is withdrawn.
acceptance: Fix the merged doc comment on settle_expired_pending_begin, and make C1 prove the attempt-start expiry check is done
